verdict.rationale: Jira's marketing docs explicitly claim customizable fields and workflows (jira-docs-3), and community evidence confirms Jira offers substantial customization ('offers a good amount of customization too' jira-comm-3), consistent with its long-standing reputation for configurable workflows/fields. However, other community comments describe customization leading to bloat/complexity requiring dedicated admins (jira-comm-12), which is a caveat but not a concrete contradiction that the feature doesn't work. Missing for 10: independent hands-on walkthrough of the workflow/field editor UI, and more detailed first-party documentation beyond a marketing bullet.
